author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI is dumb.  It lacks common sense. 

I created a skill to file expense reports on Concur, then I ask Claude Code to update an expense report, it doesn't invoke the Concur skill. 

I asked why, it said it thinks the Concur skill can only create new expense reports, it doesn't know Concur can update expense reports too 
😮‍💨
